```lean
import Mathlib

set_option maxHeartbeats 0

open Real

theorem algebra_9onxpypzleqsum2onxpy
  (x y z : ℝ)
  (h₀ : 0 < x ∧ 0 < y ∧ 0 < z) :
  9 / (x + y + z) ≤ 2 / (x + y) + 2 / (y + z) + 2 / (z + x) := by
  -- extract positivity of the variables and of the relevant sums
  rcases h₀ with ⟨hx, hy, hz⟩
  have hxy : 0 < x + y := add_pos hx hy
  have hyz : 0 < y + z := add_pos hy hz
  have hzx : 0 < z + x := add_pos hz hx
  have hsum : 0 < x + y + z := add_pos (add_pos hx hy) hz
  have hne_xy : (x + y) ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hxy
  have hne_yz : (y + z) ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hyz
  have hne_zx : (z + x) ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hzx
  have hne_sum : (x + y + z) ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hsum
  -- clear denominators (all are positive, so the direction of the inequality is preserved)
  have hmul :
      9 * (x + y) * (y + z) * (z + x) ≤
        2 * (x + y + z) * (y + z) * (z + x) +
        2 * (x + y + z) * (x + y) * (z + x) +
        2 * (x + y + z) * (x + y) * (y + z) := by
    field_simp [hne_xy, hne_yz, hne_zx, hne_sum] 
  -- divide by the positive product (x+y)*(y+z)*(z+x)
  have hpos_prod : 0 < (x + y) * (y + z) * (z + x) := by
    have : 0 < x + y := hxy
    have : 0 < y + z := hyz
    have : 0 < z + x := hzx
    positivity
  have hdiv :
      9 / (x + y + z) ≤
        2 / (x + y) + 2 / (y + z) + 2 / (z + x) := by
    have := (div_le_iff hpos_prod).mpr hmul
    -- simplify the right‑hand side of the obtained inequality
    simpa [mul_comm, mul_left_comm, mul_assoc,
      div_mul_eq_mul_div, mul_div_cancel' _ hne_sum] using this
  exact hdiv
```
